What we need from you to finalize an invoice estimate:
- Confirm expected monthly token volume (ballpark OK)
- Any target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (procurement has a threshold)
- Desired billing cadence & PO requirements

Attached: Redwood_Estimate_Acme_v1.xlsx — initial cost model (conservative assumptions). I called out two scenarios: On-demand hosted vs 12-month reserved capacity (committed).

1) Jordan: send ballpark tokens/month (you said you could pull weekly metrics)
2) We’ll update the estimate to show unit economics at your target $/1M and return an invoice-ready line item sheet
3) If it’s in range, I’ll loop in finance/ops for PO/invoice and SOW/DocuSign

Thanks — talk soon.

Thanks Sean — good call. Quick answers:
- We pulled telemetry: expected steady-state ~200M tokens/month (avg), with occasional peaks to ~350M in campaign weeks.
- Our procurement target is roughly $20–$25 / 1M tokens (total delivered cost) to make the TCO work for our margin targets.
- Billing: monthly invoices, Acme PO required, 30-day net terms. Procurement will need an invoice with line items and committed vs on-demand comparison.

Can you provide an invoice estimate tied to the 200M tokens/month scenario and show the effective monthly and annual costs at $20/1M vs $25/1M? Also please include any one-time onboarding fees and an option for a 12-month committed discount (we’re open to committing if unit economics improve).

Taylor, looping you to confirm procurement steps.

Jordan/Taylor — thanks for the numbers. Attached are updated artifacts:
- Pricing_Calculator_Acme.csv — line-item calculator you can drop into procurement templates
- Redwood_Estimate_Acme_v2.xlsx — cost modeling (on-demand vs reserved) with sensitivity table
- Cost_Breakdown_Acme.pdf — one-page unit economics explanation

Key numbers called out (200M tokens/month scenario):
- Proposed committed rate (12-month): $18.00 / 1M tokens (monthly commitment = $3,600)
- On-demand rate: $22.00 / 1M tokens
- Example monthly spend (200M tokens):
  - At $18/1M = $3,600 / month (committed)
  - At $22/1M = $4,400 / month (on-demand)
- Annual run-rate (committed, no change in consumption): $43,200

Unit economics summary (per 1M tokens):
- Model inference compute (avg): $9.00 / 1M
- Caching & network egress amortized: $2.00 / 1M
- Ops & SRE margin + support: $3.00 / 1M
- Platform licensing & management: $4.00 / 1M
- Proposed committed price: $18.00 / 1M (includes all of the above + reserved discount)

Notes & optional line items:
- One-time onboarding & secure VPC setup (if private deployment): $12,000 (one-time)
- SOC2 & compliance evidence package review: $1,500 (one-time)
- Volume bands: we can add step-down pricing above 1B tokens/month — happy to include a graduated table if you expect growth.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm committed vs on-demand preference and whether you need the private/VPC option (changes onboarding fee).
2) If committed, I’ll generate an invoice-ready PDF and SOW/DocuSign for signature and loop in finance for PO details.
3) Marissa (cc) will own the SOW and billing terms; Laura will support the procurement questions.

I attached the CSV so procurement can import the line items directly. Let me know if you need the numbers split by token type (prompt vs completion) — we can provide that too.

Regards,
